name: scene-abri
title: Abri
description: Deccani cloud paper being made: drops of indigo, ochre, madder and grey-green land on a tray of size and push each other into rings by the area-preserving marbling map, a stylus combs them, a curl drift billows them, and a sheet is laid, lifted and turned to show its print. Quiet is the print as a still; warm makes sheet after sheet; playful takes a hand in the size (pointer, or arrow keys and Enter to drop a colour).
